description: This file contains multiple functions that set up mock server expectations using the 'mockserver-client' library. It includes functions for forwarding requests over HTTP and HTTPS, overriding requests and responses, modifying request parameters, and using templates for dynamic responses.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTP
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to forward requests to a specified host and port over HTTP.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTPS
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to forward requests to a specified host and port over HTTPS.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequest
methods.description: Creates an expectation to override the forwarded request's path and headers.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Overrides both request and response bodies for a forwarded request.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedRequest
methods.description: Overrides request headers, body, path, and query parameters with modifications.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Overrides request and response with modifications, including headers, cookies, body, and path.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestAndChangeHostAndPort
methods.description: Overrides request with a different host and port in socket address.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestWithDelay
methods.description: Sets up a delayed response for a forwarded request.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForward
methods.description: Uses a JavaScript template to dynamically generate a forwarded request.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForwardWithDelay
methods.description: Uses a JavaScript template with delay to generate a forwarded request.

methods.name: velocityTemplatedForward
methods.description: Uses a Velocity template to generate a forwarded request.
